canonical_decision.property_authority: Build B selected assertions through a future condition-aware adapter

implementations.name: FormulaState modeled headspace and OAV
implementations.claim_impact: Current canonical screening path; modified-Raoult arithmetic is bounded by mixed property authority, generic activity coefficients, matrix completeness, and lack of headspace validation.
implementations.disposition: Keep unchanged through C0; adapt to the versioned equilibrium interface only after C1-C4 gates.

implementations.name: FormulaState composition-change recomputation
conditions: reuses constant material properties from base state
implementations.claim_impact: Propagates the same heuristic equilibrium model through temporal frames; not an independent measured state.
implementations.disposition: Preserve as a legacy adapter until C6 replaces dynamic evolution.

implementations.name: Standalone OAV/headspace report script
implementations.claim_impact: Can disagree with FormulaState and must not answer canonical headspace requests.
implementations.disposition: Freeze representative output; deprecate as non-runtime after migration comparison.

implementations.name: SolventLedger carrier and matrix reconciliation
implementations.claim_impact: Defines whether current headspace represents concentrate, proxy, partial matrix, or explicit finished matrix.
implementations.disposition: Preserve in C0; C2 replaces generic labels with versioned MatrixComposition.

implementations.name: Pipeline exponential-loss temporal simulator
outputs: SimulationFrame sequence with remaining formula and recomputed OAV
implementations.claim_impact: Current canonical temporal diagnostic; cannot support longevity hours or physical release rate.
implementations.disposition: Keep unchanged through C0; replace behind the router only after C5-C6 calibration and validation.

implementations.name: Standalone open-surface thermo trajectory
implementations.claim_impact: A competing dynamic-release answer with no canonical runtime caller.
implementations.disposition: Freeze output and deprecate non-runtime; reuse arithmetic only through a versioned C6 adapter if validated.

implementations.name: TemporalEngine graph, evaporation, intensity, and projection model
implementations.claim_impact: Competes with the pipeline simulator and can emit numerical projection without a validated distance-time protocol.
implementations.disposition: Route no new callers; preserve fixture and require explicit migration before deprecation.

implementations.name: Reconstruction temporal-consistency rules
implementations.claim_impact: Useful reconstruction constraint, not a physical release or wear-time measurement.
implementations.disposition: Retain as advisory under its real name; never adapt as the C6 physical release model.

implementations.name: Standalone modified-Raoult headspace
implementations.claim_impact: A second headspace engine with assumptions and inputs different from FormulaState.
implementations.disposition: No direct product callers; freeze and adapt only as an internal C4 implementation after condition contracts exist.

implementations.name: Antoine equation branch
evidence_labels: measured:data_spine.antoine when registry source supports it
implementations.claim_impact: Equation evaluation is exact for valid coefficients; result authority still depends on convention, units, phase, purity, range, and source.
implementations.disposition: Retain arithmetic; wrap in the condition-aware C1 vapor-pressure contract.

implementations.name: Clausius-Clapeyron vapor-pressure branch
implementations.claim_impact: Equation arithmetic is exact for supplied assumptions; it is not evidence that the inputs or constant-dHvap approximation are valid.
implementations.disposition: Retain arithmetic behind C1 applicability and range checks.

implementations.name: Constant reference vapor-pressure fallback
conditions: used when no Antoine or dHvap is supplied
consumers: any direct vp_pa caller that omits dHvap
implementations.claim_impact: Silently ignores temperature dependence and cannot support release-grade extrapolation.
implementations.disposition: C1 must return lower authority or WITHHELD outside the reference condition.

implementations.name: VP25-derived enthalpy correlation
implementations.claim_impact: Temperature correction is literature-derived but not material-specific measurement and cannot promote headspace beyond its weakest input/model.
implementations.disposition: Represent as an explicit C1 model with source, domain, and uncertainty.

implementations.name: Synthetic Antoine coefficients from dHvap
implementations.claim_impact: Names synthetic coefficients as Antoine parameters without a measured multi-temperature fit.
implementations.disposition: Do not use for release-grade C1 results; preserve only as a versioned legacy adapter if a caller is found.

implementations.name: SMILES group-feature vapor-pressure estimator
conditions: internal training table and rule multipliers
implementations.claim_impact: May populate approximate properties but is not a measured lookup or release-grade vapor-pressure model.
implementations.disposition: Keep outside canonical model selection unless C1 records its fit/domain/uncertainty explicitly.

implementations.name: Reconstruction vapor-pressure and sillage classifier
implementations.claim_impact: Can emit physical-sounding evaporation and sillage values without validated endpoints.
implementations.disposition: Retain only as reconstruction heuristic and rename claims through adapters if exposed.

implementations.name: DIPPR-style vapor-pressure equation
implementations.claim_impact: The repository cannot claim DIPPR-style equation support.
implementations.disposition: Remain WITHHELD until C1 adds a versioned equation form with coefficients, units, range, source, and validation.

implementations.name: Hansen-distance regular-solution gamma heuristic
implementations.claim_impact: Dominates non-ideal headspace estimates without perfume-domain calibration.
implementations.disposition: Keep labeled heuristic; C3-C5 may replace it only through a versioned, applicable, validated model.

implementations.name: FormulaState profile activity-coefficient branch
outputs: fixed gamma independent of current composition
conditions: used when HSP is missing and profile coefficient exists
implementations.claim_impact: A second gamma path can differ from the composition-dependent Hansen heuristic.
implementations.disposition: Expose as a separately versioned fallback or WITHHELD in C3; never silently mix authorities.

implementations.name: Chemical-class activity-coefficient estimator
implementations.claim_impact: May seed profile gamma values but is not UNIFAC or empirical formula-domain calibration.
implementations.disposition: Keep non-canonical unless explicitly declared as a low-authority C3 fallback.

implementations.name: Optimizer logP-to-gamma rule
conditions: hard-coded relationship described as calibrated against UNIFAC families
implementations.claim_impact: Competing optimizer gamma can differ from FormulaState unless the optimizer uses the canonical state map.
implementations.disposition: Prevent new physical claims; migrate optimizer to router results and retain only as legacy fixture.

implementations.name: UNIFAC activity-model capability boundary
implementations.claim_impact: Correctly prevents dependency presence from being mislabeled as an active UNIFAC implementation.
implementations.disposition: Remain inactive until subgroup assignment, parameters, versioning, domain checks, and validation pass C3-C5.

implementations.name: Science-KB UNIFAC group catalogue
evidence_labels: data presence is not model activation
implementations.claim_impact: Table population alone cannot support UNIFAC activity coefficients.
implementations.disposition: Keep as non-authoritative reference data until C3 implements and validates a real versioned algorithm.

implementations.name: Hansen RED phase and bloom rules
implementations.claim_impact: Supports phase-risk screening but not measured solubility, phase equilibrium, or stability.
implementations.disposition: Retain as a clearly named heuristic; C2/C9 must define applicability and measured promotion criteria.

implementations.name: Pairwise Hansen distance arithmetic
conditions: stored HSP values may be estimated
implementations.claim_impact: Arithmetic is exact but cannot elevate uncertain HSP inputs into measured compatibility.
implementations.disposition: Reuse only inside a versioned model that carries source and applicability.

implementations.name: COSMO-RS interface or import
conditions: no executable interface or import found
implementations.claim_impact: The repository cannot claim COSMO-RS activity or partition prediction.
implementations.disposition: Remain WITHHELD unless a later evidence-gated phase adds a licensed/versioned interface and validation.

implementations.name: Character-zone Hill dose-response scorer
implementations.claim_impact: Numerical Hill outputs are not material-specific receptor or sensory dose-response evidence.
implementations.disposition: Keep outside physical/sensory claim authority until C9 evidence and validation exist.

implementations.name: Cross-adaptation and mixture psychophysics scorer
implementations.claim_impact: Cannot support universal sensory clarity, anosmia, or adaptation claims.
implementations.disposition: Retain only as advisory legacy output and require C9 evidence before promotion.

implementations.name: OAV target bands and cliff rules
conditions: inherits modeled headspace and threshold authority
implementations.claim_impact: Transforms heuristic OAV into style guidance; cannot be treated as measured perception.
implementations.disposition: Keep separate from C4 equilibrium and C8 sensory outputs; preserve explicit authority labels.

implementations.name: Generic natural-composite constituent headspace and OAV
implementations.claim_impact: Improves transparency over a fake bulk molecule but cannot represent the actual supplier lot or regulatory constituent composition.
implementations.disposition: Preserve as explicit generic proxy; C7 adds lot-specific authority and abstention.

implementations.name: In-memory natural lot profile registry
conditions: no canonical persistence or runtime integration
implementations.claim_impact: A data shape exists but does not make current headspace lot-specific.
implementations.disposition: C7 must integrate canonical lot identity, provenance, uncertainty, and measured composition before use.

implementations.name: Arrhenius rate arithmetic
implementations.claim_impact: Correct arithmetic does not validate the reaction network or parameters for a perfume formula.
implementations.disposition: Retain arithmetic under a versioned kinetic model with measured parameters and applicability.

implementations.name: Maturation reaction and shelf-life predictor
implementations.claim_impact: Canonical gate text currently presents a numerical shelf-life prediction without formula/lot-specific validation.
implementations.disposition: C9 must relabel or withhold unsupported shelf-life claims until measured stability calibration exists.

implementations.name: Odor-family-prior receptor occupancy
conditions: family priors substitute for material-specific affinity/efficacy
evidence_labels: family prior is not assay data
implementations.claim_impact: Cannot support production receptor activation or perception claims.
implementations.disposition: Keep disconnected from canonical workbench; C9 requires material-specific assay evidence and exposure transfer.

implementations.name: Glomerular vector, novelty, and configural blur transforms
implementations.claim_impact: Mathematical transforms cannot rescue unsupported receptor inputs or imply human neural response.
implementations.disposition: Keep non-production and preserve only as legacy fixture.

implementations.name: Fixed-timescale receptor adaptation
implementations.claim_impact: Cannot predict human fatigue or recovery for a perfume dose.
implementations.disposition: Keep disconnected; C9 requires protocol-specific evidence.

implementations.name: Material-name adaptation penalty
implementations.claim_impact: A separate adaptation answer can conflict with receptor adaptation and psychophysics rules.
implementations.disposition: Do not expose as calibrated adaptation; consolidate under C9 evidence contracts.

implementations.name: Fixed-valence hedonic scorer
implementations.claim_impact: Cannot support population-specific liking or quality claims.
implementations.disposition: Retain as legacy design heuristic only; C9 requires panel protocol and held-out validation.

implementations.name: Kaw/MW diffusion-field and sillage scorer
implementations.claim_impact: Produces physical-sounding reach classes and projection without geometry, airflow, dose, or held-out distance measurements.
implementations.disposition: Do not route to canonical sillage; C6/C9 require endpoint-specific dynamic and measurement models.

implementations.name: Skin reservoir and fabric substantivity scorer
conditions: known-material classification and mass are appended inside the branch and again by the shared post-branch block
evidence_labels: duplicate accounting regression locked by C0-LH-008
implementations.claim_impact: The current shared post-branch block duplicates known-material rows and mass accounting, so category percentages can exceed 100%; frozen case C0-LH-008 reports 140.0% reservoir. These outputs may imply skin persistence but do not model dose, wearer, vehicle, or measured release.
implementations.disposition: Freeze the duplicate-accounting defect without changing C0 runtime; C6/C9 must separate substrate partition arithmetic from calibrated longevity endpoints.

implementations.name: Potts-Guy skin partition and depot release helper
conditions: Potts-Guy relation with heuristic sebum/fabric modifiers
implementations.claim_impact: Literature-derived permeability arithmetic is transferred beyond its original context and mixed with heuristic retention/release factors.
implementations.disposition: Separate exact/literature components and applicability in C9; do not infer longevity.

implementations.name: Legacy backend note-weighted longevity estimate
conditions: no matrix, dose, substrate, or wear data
consumers: legacy backend callers only; not canonical formula API
implementations.claim_impact: Emits hours without calibration and must not override workbench abstention.
implementations.disposition: Deprecate from physical claims; preserve fixture until proven unused.

implementations.name: Legacy backend note-weighted sillage estimate
consumers: legacy backend callers only; not canonical formula API
implementations.claim_impact: Emits a sillage category without projection measurements and must not override workbench abstention.
implementations.disposition: Deprecate from physical claims; preserve fixture until proven unused.

implementations.name: Canonical workbench longevity/sillage/receptor abstention
implementations.claim_impact: This fail-closed behavior is the current canonical authority for unsupported endpoints.
implementations.disposition: Preserve until claim-specific C5/C6/C9 validation gates pass.

implementations.name: Unified release impact/tenacity/diffusion scoring
conditions: deterministic transforms of heuristic OAV and rules
implementations.claim_impact: Physical-sounding score names can be mistaken for measurements unless labels remain explicit.
implementations.disposition: Keep advisory and route future measured claims through separate C6/C8 result types.

implementations.name: In-sample linear score calibration pipeline
conditions: no mandatory held-out split or domain grouping
implementations.claim_impact: A fitted coefficient alone does not establish generalization or endpoint validity.
implementations.disposition: C5 must add protocol, split, baseline, metrics, uncertainty, and domain gates before promotion.

implementations.name: Standalone formula simulator score bundle
implementations.claim_impact: Can produce a separate physical score bundle for the same formula.
implementations.disposition: Freeze and deprecate as non-runtime after caller proof; do not adapt as the C router.

implementations.name: Optimizer composite physical and sensory scoring runtime
conditions: mixes canonical thermodynamic state with multiple uncalibrated modules
implementations.claim_impact: A major competing call path can influence optimization even when canonical workbench outputs abstain.
implementations.disposition: C10 must consume versioned router results and preserve unsupported gates; C0 changes no scoring behavior.
